rules: Writer rationale and writer quality claims are excluded from comparative evidence.
Candidate ambition level may be retained for audit metadata but not exposed as a prestige cue in blinded comparison.
When a swap is available, orientation two reverses the substantive left/right identities.
A left-side or right-side preference that does not track the substantive text after swap is POSITION_BIAS_SUSPECTED.
When swap evidence is unavailable, the evaluator may proceed only with lower confidence and cannot convert uncertainty into a win.
